item.name: Void Mass
item.unlock: Evolve for the first time after v1.2.0.
item.inGameHint: This entity is manifested in the void.
item.notes: If you already evolved before the companion update, evolve again to claim it. This is the Evolution companion, not a separate fruit stage.
item.cardSummary: Void Mass is the Evolution companion. Complete one Evolution after the v1.2.0 companion update, then equip it from the Companions menu.

item.name: Mysterious Tree
item.unlock: Grow a 10-star fruit tree in the Orchard.
item.inGameHint: Can be found in a good orchard garden.
item.notes: If it does not unlock after harvest, rejoin a public server and try again. A 10-star tree is easier with Ascendent Fertilizer and Lucky Clovers.
item.cardSummary: Mysterious Tree is the Orchard companion. Grow a 10-star fruit tree, harvest it, and rejoin a public server if the unlock does not register.

item.name: Fruit Aura
item.unlock: Reach 100% game completion by collecting every badge.
item.inGameHint: This is the last official milestone you achieve.
item.notes: Hard badges such as Good Samaritan and Cosmic Farmer count toward this.
item.cardSummary: Fruit Aura is the completion companion. It unlocks when every badge is earned and the game shows 100% completion.

item.name: Angel
item.inGameHint: Granted at the holy number of ascensions.
item.notes: This is a long-term prestige target, not a short-session unlock.
item.cardSummary: Angel is the late-game prestige companion. It unlocks at 777 Ascensions and does not come from shops or codes.

item.name: UFO
item.unlock: Collect it when it spawns frequently during an Alien Invasion.
item.inGameHint: Frequently acquired during a very chaotic event.
item.notes: It only appears while Alien Invasion is live. This companion is not the UFO Key.
item.cardSummary: UFO is an Alien Invasion companion. Grab it when it spawns frequently during that live event. It is not the UFO Key.

item.name: Glorp Cat
item.unlock: Collect it when it spawns infrequently during an Alien Invasion.
item.inGameHint: Uncommonly acquired during a very chaotic event.
item.notes: It only appears while Alien Invasion is live, and it spawns less often than UFO.
item.cardSummary: Glorp Cat is the rarer Alien Invasion companion. It spawns less often than UFO and only while the event is running.
